value: No impact from energy derivative contract remeasurements; no additional business acquisitions, restructurings, or legal settlements concluded.
AWS grew 36.7% year over year in Q2, its fastest growth in 18 quarters; AWS AI and Chips businesses each exceeded $25 billion annual revenue run rates.

Stores set record Prime delivery speeds in the first half; over 40% more items were delivered same-day or overnight; Grocery and Everyday Essentials grew meaningfully faster than the rest of the business.

In May 2026 Xockets filed an ITC complaint against Amazon.com, Amazon Web Services, Annapurna Labs, NVIDIA, and Microsoft concerning specified AWS/NVIDIA infrastructure products; in June 2026 the International Trade Commission instituted an investigation.

Definitive merger agreement entered April 13, 2026; cash/stock consideration; approximately $10.9 billion implied value including debt as of agreement date; expected close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals and satellite replacement milestones.

Q2 2026 technology and infrastructure costs include net unrealized gains for energy contracts subject to derivative accounting; fair value measurements do not affect cash flows but may be material to future technology and infrastructure costs due to contract duration and valuation volatility.
